description: Jobs listed on Internshala's public /jobs/ page, read from the schema.org ItemList the page embeds: job title and detail-page link, in page order. The list gives only titles and links; company, location and pay are not in it, so they are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_infojobs when you need newest offers on InfoJobs' public Spanish job list page; jobs_governmentjobs when you need US public-sector job postings from GovernmentJobs.com. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
